title: Safety and Tolerability of Lacosamide in Patients With Epilepsy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: Comparison: for RCTs and cohort studies, the comparison was placebo or other types of pharmacotherapies. For case series, there was no comparison.
adjudication.k_quote: Eighty-three studies involving 12268 populations (11 randomized clinical trials (RCTs), 16 cohort studies, 53 case series, and 3 case reports) were included in our study.
adjudication.reason: Mixed-design review pooling single-arm AE incidence across all designs; no pooled RCT-only pairwise synthesis is reported.
